_meta.about: Batch 009: Nifty 500 companies from RHI Magnesita to UCO Bank. Leaders checked against web reports as of Oct 2026 where as_of says so; the rest are marked not re-checked because search limits were hit.
_meta.review: All entries unreviewed until the founder approves them.

companies.name: RHI Magnesita India

parts.SELLS: RHI Magnesita India makes refractories: heat-resistant bricks, castables and linings that protect furnaces, kilns and ladles. Its buyers are steel plants first, then cement, glass and non-ferrous metal makers. It is the Indian arm of the global RHI Magnesita group and absorbed the Dalmia OCL refractory business in 2023.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling refractory products and by running full-service contracts where it manages a customer's furnace linings and gets paid for performance. Steel is by far its largest customer industry, so its sales track how much steel India produces.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest refractory companies, and part of the world's biggest refractory group by most industry estimates. It runs several plants across India and supplies most of the country's large steelmakers.
parts.RIVALS: Vesuvius India, IFGL Refractories, Calderys and a long tail of smaller domestic refractory makers, along with in-house suppliers linked to large steel groups.
parts.WATCH: Pankaj Malhan took over as MD & CEO in July 2026, with former chief Parmod Sagar staying on as chairman. Follow how it serves the new blast furnaces Indian steelmakers have announced, and raw-material costs for magnesia and alumina.

quiz.prompt: What does RHI Magnesita India mainly make?
Which customer industry matters most to RHI Magnesita India?
Who became RHI Magnesita India's MD & CEO in July 2026?

companies.note_30w: RHI Magnesita India makes heat-resistant refractory linings, mainly for steel plants, as the Indian arm of a global group, now led by new CEO Pankaj Malhan.

companies.name: RITES

parts.SELLS: RITES is a Railways Ministry company that sells transport know-how: consultancy and design for railways, metros, ports and highways, quality inspection of materials, and turnkey construction. It also exports and leases locomotives and coaches, mostly to countries in South Asia and Africa.
parts.EARNS: Consultancy and inspection fees are its steadiest, highest-margin income. Turnkey projects and rolling-stock exports add lumpier revenue that depends on a few large orders, while locomotive leasing brings regular rental income.
parts.SIZE: India's best-known government transport consultancy and one of the country's leading exporters of railway rolling stock. It has Navratna status, giving it more freedom to take on large projects at home and abroad.
parts.RIVALS: Consultancy: Systra, Egis and AECOM. Construction and railway work: IRCON International, RVNL and private EPC firms. Rolling-stock exports compete with Chinese and European makers.
parts.WATCH: The Railways Ministry let Rahul Mithal continue as CMD beyond October 2026 until his retirement in 2027. Watch its export order wins abroad, its push into metro and urban transport consultancy, and new business from India's railway safety upgrades.

quiz.prompt: Which of these is NOT a RITES business?
Which RITES income stream is the steadiest and highest-margin?
Which company is a rival to RITES in railway construction?

companies.note_30w: RITES is a government transport consultancy that also inspects materials, builds projects and exports locomotives, with consultancy fees as its most dependable income stream.

companies.name: RailTel Corporation of India

parts.SELLS: RailTel is a Railways Ministry telecom company that owns an optical fibre network laid along railway tracks. It leases bandwidth to telecom operators, sells internet to homes under the RailWire brand, runs Wi-Fi at railway stations and builds IT and network projects for government departments.
parts.EARNS: It earns from leasing bandwidth and towers, from enterprise connectivity and from system-integration projects for ministries, states and PSUs. Project work now brings in a large share of revenue but at thinner margins than its core telecom services.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest neutral telecom infrastructure providers, with a fibre network that reaches most railway stations in the country. It is a Navratna company and one of the biggest providers of public Wi-Fi in India.
parts.RIVALS: In bandwidth and enterprise links: Bharti Airtel, Jio, Tata Communications and BSNL. In government IT projects: firms like TCIL, ITI and private system integrators.
parts.WATCH: Watch how it balances low-margin project work with its own telecom services, new work on railway signalling and Kavach safety networks, and the growth of RailWire home broadband.

quiz.prompt: What is RailTel's home broadband brand?
Where is RailTel's fibre network mainly laid?
Which is a rival to RailTel in enterprise connectivity?

companies.note_30w: RailTel uses its fibre network along railway tracks to lease bandwidth, sell RailWire broadband, run station Wi-Fi and deliver government IT projects across India.

companies.name: Rainbow Children's Medicare

parts.SELLS: Rainbow runs hospitals that specialise in children and women: paediatric care, neonatal intensive care, obstetrics and fertility. Its brands are Rainbow Children's Hospital and BirthRight by Rainbow, with most hospitals in Hyderabad and other South Indian cities, and newer ones in the north and east.
parts.EARNS: It earns from inpatient stays, surgeries, newborn intensive care and outpatient visits. Paediatric specialty and critical care is its largest and most profitable line, while its mature Hyderabad hospitals generate the strongest margins.
parts.SIZE: India's largest multi-specialty paediatric hospital chain by most estimates, with a strong lead in newborn and children's intensive care. Its Hyderabad hospitals are among the best-known children's hospitals in South India.
parts.RIVALS: Cloudnine, Motherhood Hospitals and Apollo Cradle in women and child care, plus children's departments at big chains like Apollo Hospitals, Manipal and KIMS.
parts.WATCH: Watch its announced hospital expansion into new cities, how new units ramp up, and its hub-and-spoke model of linking smaller centres to big hubs. It named Abrarali Dalal CEO in January 2026, alongside founder Dr. Kancharla.

quiz.prompt: Which patients does Rainbow mainly focus on?
Which is Rainbow's most profitable line?
Which brand competes with Rainbow in maternity care?

companies.note_30w: Rainbow Children's Medicare runs South India-rooted hospitals for children and women, earning most from paediatric and newborn critical care, and is expanding into new cities.

companies.name: Ramkrishna Forgings

parts.SELLS: Ramkrishna Forgings makes forged and machined steel parts: axle components, crankshafts, gears and other parts for trucks, buses and tractors, plus components for railways, oil and gas and other industries. Its buyers include Indian and global truck makers.
parts.EARNS: It earns by supplying parts under long-running contracts with vehicle makers. Commercial vehicles are its largest market, and exports to truck makers in North America and Europe make up a meaningful share of sales.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger forging companies and a major supplier of truck and heavy-vehicle components. It is among the few Indian forgers that supply big global truck makers in North America and Europe.
parts.RIVALS: Bharat Forge, Happy Forgings and MM Forgings in India, plus global forging suppliers that serve truck makers worldwide. In railway wheels, it faces imports and the Indian Railways' own wheel factories.
parts.WATCH: Naresh Jalan was reappointed MD from November 2026, with Chaitanya Jalan as joint MD. Watch its railway wheel joint venture with Titagarh, its move into non-auto parts, and demand from the Indian and US truck markets.

quiz.prompt: Which vehicles are Ramkrishna Forgings' biggest market?
Which company is a rival of Ramkrishna Forgings?
Ramkrishna Forgings has a railway wheel joint venture with which company?

companies.note_30w: Ramkrishna Forgings makes forged steel parts mainly for trucks and buses in India and abroad, and is building railway wheels with Titagarh.

companies.name: Redington

parts.SELLS: Redington is a technology distributor. It buys laptops, phones, servers, software and cloud services from brands such as Apple, HP, Dell, Lenovo and Microsoft and supplies them to thousands of resellers and retailers. It operates in India, the Middle East, Africa and Turkey.
parts.EARNS: It earns a thin margin on very large volumes of products it moves, plus higher margins on cloud, software and IT solutions. Mobility, led by smartphones, and PCs make up the biggest share of revenue; India and the Middle East are its two main regions.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest IT and mobility distributors, and among the biggest technology distributors in the Middle East and Africa. It is one of Apple's major distribution partners in India.
parts.RIVALS: Ingram Micro, Savex Technologies, Rashi Peripherals, Supertron and iValue in India; Ingram Micro and regional distributors in the Gulf and Africa. Brands selling directly to large retailers also cut into its role.
parts.WATCH: Watch its push into cloud and software distribution, its working-capital and credit discipline on huge volumes, and how its Turkey and Africa businesses perform.

quiz.prompt: What does Redington mainly do?
Which product area brings Redington the largest revenue?
Which is a rival distributor to Redington?

companies.note_30w: Redington distributes phones, laptops, servers and cloud services from global brands across India, the Middle East and Africa, earning thin margins on very large volumes.

companies.name: Reliance Power

parts.SELLS: Reliance Power, part of the Anil Ambani group, generates and sells electricity. Its main assets are the coal-fired Sasan ultra mega power plant in Madhya Pradesh and the Rosa plant in Uttar Pradesh. It is now building solar and battery storage projects through its arm Reliance NU Energies.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling power to state distribution companies under long-term agreements, with Sasan supplying most of its revenue at regulated tariffs. Paying down debt has used a large part of its cash in recent years.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger private power producers, best known for running one of the country's biggest coal power plants at Sasan. It is the main listed power company of the Anil Ambani group.
parts.RIVALS: Tata Power, Adani Power, JSW Energy and NTPC in thermal power. In renewables and storage, it competes with Adani Green, ReNew, Tata Power Renewables and other solar developers.
parts.WATCH: Watch progress on its solar-plus-storage projects and plans in Bhutan, its debt reduction, and enforcement and regulatory probes involving the Anil Ambani group and its companies.

quiz.prompt: Which group does Reliance Power belong to?
Which plant supplies most of Reliance Power's revenue?
Which arm is Reliance Power using for solar and battery projects?

companies.note_30w: Reliance Power, an Anil Ambani group firm, earns mostly from its Sasan coal plant and is shifting toward solar and battery storage while cutting debt.

companies.name: Rubicon Research

parts.SELLS: Rubicon Research develops and makes generic and specialty medicines, mostly for the US market. Its strengths are hard-to-make formulations such as nasal sprays, oral liquids and modified-release tablets. It listed on the NSE in October 2025.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling approved generic drugs to US distributors and pharmacies, so the US brings in most of its revenue. Its own research pipeline of product filings with the US drug regulator drives future sales.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized Indian pharma company and one of the faster-growing Indian generic makers focused on the US specialty market. It has a growing list of products approved by the US drug regulator.
parts.RIVALS: Indian generic makers selling in the US such as Lupin, Zydus Lifesciences, Glenmark and Alembic, along with US and global generic companies. In nasal sprays it competes with a small group of specialists.
parts.WATCH: Watch new product approvals from the US drug regulator, inspections of its manufacturing sites, and its 2026 move to build an Indian branded business through the Arinna Lifesciences acquisition.

quiz.prompt: Which market brings Rubicon Research most of its revenue?
Which of these is a Rubicon Research specialty?
Which company did Rubicon buy a stake in to grow in India?

companies.note_30w: Rubicon Research develops hard-to-make generic medicines like nasal sprays mainly for the US market, and is building an Indian business through Arinna Lifesciences.

companies.name: SBI Card

parts.SELLS: SBI Card issues credit cards: SimplyCLICK, SimplySAVE, SBI Card ELITE, PRIME and many co-branded cards with partners such as IRCTC, BPCL, Air India and Reliance. It is a subsidiary of State Bank of India and sells many of its cards through SBI branches.
parts.EARNS: It earns interest when cardholders carry balances or convert spends into EMIs, plus interchange fees on every swipe and annual fees. Interest on revolving balances and EMIs is its biggest income source, which also exposes it to credit losses.
parts.SIZE: India's second-largest credit card issuer after HDFC Bank, and the largest standalone card company in the country. Its link with SBI gives it access to the biggest bank customer base in India.
parts.RIVALS: HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank and Axis Bank are its main card rivals. Kotak Mahindra Bank, IDFC First Bank and fintech card partnerships with apps such as OneCard also chase the same customers.
parts.WATCH: Watch credit costs and defaults among cardholders, RBI rules on co-branded cards and card networks, and spending on UPI-linked RuPay credit cards. Salila Pande has led it as MD & CEO since April 2025.

quiz.prompt: Which bank is SBI Card's parent?
What is SBI Card's biggest income source?
options: Interest on revolving balances and EMIs

quiz.prompt: Which issuer is larger than SBI Card in credit cards?

companies.note_30w: SBI Card, a State Bank of India subsidiary, is India's second-largest credit card issuer, earning mainly from interest on balances and EMIs plus swipe fees.

companies.name: SPR Auto Technologies (formerly Shriram Pistons & Rings)

parts.SELLS: SPR Auto Technologies makes pistons, piston rings, pins and engine valves for two-wheelers, cars, tractors and trucks, and is adding parts for electric vehicles. The company was called Shriram Pistons & Rings until it renamed itself in April 2026 to reflect the wider product range.
parts.EARNS: It earns by supplying engine parts to vehicle makers and by selling replacement parts in the aftermarket and abroad. Supplies to Indian vehicle makers are the largest share, while aftermarket sales carry better margins.
parts.SIZE: India's largest maker of pistons and piston rings by most industry estimates. It supplies most major Indian two-wheeler, car and tractor makers and exports to global vehicle and engine makers.
parts.RIVALS: Mahle, Federal-Mogul (now part of Tenneco), India Pistons and Rane Engine Valve in India, along with Chinese and European suppliers in export markets.
parts.WATCH: Watch how it diversifies beyond engine parts as electric vehicles grow. Management has said it is exploring acquisitions in areas such as thermal management and mechatronics.

quiz.prompt: What was SPR Auto Technologies called before April 2026?
Which product is SPR Auto best known for?
Which area has management said it is exploring acquisitions in?

companies.note_30w: SPR Auto Technologies, formerly Shriram Pistons & Rings, is India's top piston maker and is renaming and acquiring to grow beyond engine parts.

companies.name: Sagility

parts.SELLS: Sagility runs back-office and technology services for the US healthcare industry. It processes insurance claims, handles member and patient calls, manages care programmes and runs billing and revenue collection for hospitals. It listed in November 2024 and is backed by EQT.
parts.EARNS: It earns fees from long-term contracts with US health insurers and hospitals, priced per transaction, per person or per outcome. Health insurers, known as payers, bring in most of its revenue.
parts.SIZE: One of the larger India-based firms focused only on US healthcare process outsourcing. It works for several of the biggest health insurers in the US and employs a large workforce in India and the Philippines.
parts.RIVALS: Cognizant, ExlService, Firstsource Solutions, Conduent and the healthcare units of Accenture and Genpact. US insurers' own in-house teams and AI tools are also competition.
parts.WATCH: Watch how it uses AI and automation in claims work, how it grows clients beyond its largest US insurers, and changes in US healthcare policy that affect its customers.

quiz.prompt: Which industry does Sagility serve?
Which customers bring Sagility most of its revenue?
Which company competes with Sagility?

companies.note_30w: Sagility processes claims, calls and billing for US health insurers and hospitals under long-term contracts, with payers bringing most of its revenue.

companies.name: Sai Life Sciences

parts.SELLS: Sai Life Sciences is a contract research, development and manufacturing company. It discovers and develops new drug molecules for global pharma and biotech firms and makes their active ingredients at scale. It listed in December 2024 and is backed by TPG.
parts.EARNS: It earns fees for research services and from manufacturing ingredients for clients' drugs. Manufacturing for late-stage and launched medicines is its larger and faster-growing business, and most clients are in the US, UK and Europe.
parts.SIZE: One of India's fastest-growing contract drug research and manufacturing firms. It works with many of the world's large pharma companies and many biotech clients.
parts.RIVALS: Syngene International, Divi's Laboratories, Aragen, Piramal Pharma Solutions and Chinese firms such as WuXi AppTec. Global players like Lonza also compete for large contracts.
parts.WATCH: Watch its announced hiring and capacity build-out in Hyderabad and Bidar, and how far global pharma firms shift work from China to India under the US Biosecure push.

quiz.prompt: What kind of company is Sai Life Sciences?
Which Sai Life business is larger and growing faster?
options: Manufacturing for late-stage and launched drugs

quiz.prompt: Which Chinese firm is a rival to Sai Life Sciences?

companies.note_30w: Sai Life Sciences researches and manufactures drug ingredients for global pharma clients, with manufacturing for late-stage drugs as its main growth engine.

companies.name: Sammaan Capital (formerly Indiabulls Housing Finance)

parts.SELLS: Sammaan Capital lends home loans and loans against property, mostly to salaried and self-employed borrowers, and has run down its old wholesale real-estate loan book. It was Indiabulls Housing Finance until it renamed itself in 2024. Abu Dhabi's IHC became its controlling shareholder in 2026.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between what it charges borrowers and what it pays to borrow. Retail home loans and loans against property are now its core book, and it also sells loans to banks under co-lending deals for fees.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger housing finance companies, though smaller than it was in the Indiabulls era. Its balance sheet is now more focused on small retail loans than on big developer loans.
parts.RIVALS: LIC Housing Finance, PNB Housing Finance, Bajaj Housing Finance and Aadhar Housing Finance, plus the home-loan arms of big banks such as SBI and HDFC Bank.
parts.WATCH: IHC got regulatory approval in 2026 to take control and will gain the right to appoint most of the board. Watch board and management changes under IHC, cheaper borrowing as a result, and how fast the retail loan book grows.

quiz.prompt: What was Sammaan Capital called before 2024?
Which investor became Sammaan Capital's controlling shareholder in 2026?
Which lender is a rival to Sammaan Capital?

companies.note_30w: Sammaan Capital, formerly Indiabulls Housing Finance, lends home loans and loans against property, and came under control of Abu Dhabi's IHC in 2026.

companies.name: Sansera Engineering

parts.SELLS: Sansera Engineering makes precision forged and machined parts: connecting rods, crankshafts, rocker arms and gear parts for two-wheelers, cars and trucks. It also supplies aerospace, defence and other industrial parts, and parts for electric vehicles.
parts.EARNS: It earns by supplying parts under long-term programmes with vehicle makers in India and abroad. Two-wheeler parts are its largest auto segment, while aerospace and non-auto parts are a smaller but faster-growing share.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading makers of precision engine and transmission components for two-wheelers and cars. It counts major Indian and global vehicle makers among its long-standing customers.
parts.RIVALS: Bharat Forge, Happy Forgings, Endurance Technologies and Musashi Seimitsu in India, along with global component suppliers. In aerospace parts, it competes with Indian and overseas precision engineering firms.
parts.WATCH: Watch its announced expansion in aerospace and defence parts, how it replaces engine-part demand as electric vehicles grow, and new export programmes with global vehicle makers.

quiz.prompt: Which Sansera product is a core engine part?
Which Sansera segment is smaller but growing faster?
Which company is a rival of Sansera Engineering?

companies.note_30w: Sansera Engineering makes precision engine and transmission parts mainly for two-wheelers and cars, and is growing aerospace and defence work.

companies.name: Sarda Energy & Minerals

parts.SELLS: Sarda Energy & Minerals makes steel products such as sponge iron, billets and wire rods, plus ferro alloys and iron ore pellets. It also generates power from hydro projects and a thermal plant it acquired, SKS Power, and mines its own coal and iron ore.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling steel, ferro alloys and power. Power sales and captive mining have become a growing and steadier share of profit, cushioning swings in steel prices.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized integrated steel and power company and one of Chhattisgarh's notable private steelmakers. Its own mines and power plants make it more self-sufficient than many similar-sized peers.
parts.RIVALS: Godawari Power & Ispat, Shyam Metalics, Jindal Steel and other secondary steel and ferro alloy producers. In power, it sells into a market dominated by NTPC, Adani Power and state utilities.
parts.WATCH: Watch its coal mine production ramp-up after approvals to raise output, how its thermal power plant performs, and its announced hydro projects. Management has said energy and mining will drive its next phase.

quiz.prompt: Which power plant did Sarda Energy acquire?
What helps cushion Sarda's earnings from steel price swings?
Which company is a rival of Sarda Energy?

companies.note_30w: Sarda Energy & Minerals makes steel and ferro alloys in Chhattisgarh, and increasingly earns from power plants and its own coal and iron ore mines.

companies.name: Schaeffler India

parts.SELLS: Schaeffler India makes bearings, engine and transmission parts, clutches and components for vehicles, railways and industrial machines under the FAG, INA and LuK brands. It is the Indian arm of Germany's Schaeffler group and also sells replacement parts to mechanics and workshops.
parts.EARNS: It earns from supplying vehicle makers, industrial customers and the aftermarket, plus exports to group companies. Automotive technologies are its largest segment, while industrial bearings and aftermarket parts add steady, profitable sales.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest bearing makers and a leading supplier of precision components to the auto industry. It runs several factories, mainly in Maharashtra, Gujarat and Tamil Nadu.
parts.RIVALS: SKF India, Timken India and NRB Bearings in bearings; Valeo and other global suppliers in clutches and transmission parts. Cheaper imported bearings also compete in the aftermarket.
parts.WATCH: Watch its components for electric vehicles and hybrids, exports to the Schaeffler group, and demand from railways and wind energy. It named Amit Bhalerao chief operating officer in 2026.

quiz.prompt: Which brand belongs to Schaeffler?
Which is Schaeffler India's largest segment?
Which company is a rival of Schaeffler India?

companies.note_30w: Schaeffler India makes FAG and INA bearings, LuK clutches and other precision parts for vehicles, railways and industry, led by its automotive segment.

companies.name: Schneider Electric Infrastructure

parts.SELLS: Schneider Electric Infrastructure makes electrical equipment for the grid: medium-voltage switchgear, distribution transformers, ring main units and grid automation systems. It is part of France's Schneider Electric group and supplies power utilities, industries, data centres and railways.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling equipment and related services, much of it on project orders. Utilities and power distribution are a large market, while industrial customers and data centres are adding fast-growing demand.
parts.SIZE: One of India's notable suppliers of medium-voltage switchgear and distribution equipment. Its factories in Vadodara and Kolkata make products for both Indian customers and export markets.
parts.RIVALS: Siemens, ABB India, Hitachi Energy India, CG Power and Lucy Electric, along with many local switchgear makers. In transformers it also faces Voltamp and other domestic firms.
parts.WATCH: It reported record quarterly order intake in mid-2026. Watch capacity additions at its factories, demand from data centres and renewable energy, and spending by state power distributors on grid upgrades.

quiz.prompt: Which global group owns Schneider Electric Infrastructure?
What does Schneider Electric Infrastructure mainly make?
Which company is a rival to Schneider Electric Infrastructure?

companies.note_30w: Schneider Electric Infrastructure makes switchgear, transformers and grid automation for utilities, industry and data centres as part of France's Schneider Electric.

companies.name: Shipping Corporation of India (SCI)

parts.SELLS: SCI is India's state-owned shipping line. It owns and operates oil and gas tankers, dry bulk carriers, container ships and offshore vessels, carrying crude for Indian refiners and cargo worldwide. Its non-core land and buildings were split into a separate listed company, SCILAL, in 2024.
parts.EARNS: It earns freight and charter hire from moving crude oil, products, gas, coal and containers. Tankers carrying crude for state oil companies are its largest and most dependable business, while freight rates make earnings swing.
parts.SIZE: India's largest shipping company by fleet, and the country's national carrier for oil imports. It has Navratna status and carries a big share of the crude bought by state-owned refiners.
parts.RIVALS: Great Eastern Shipping and Seven Islands Shipping in India, plus global ship owners and container lines such as Maersk and MSC, which carry much of India's trade.
parts.WATCH: Watch the government's long-planned privatisation, new ship orders under India's push to build its own fleet, and freight rates hit by global conflicts and shipping route disruptions.

quiz.prompt: What is SCI's largest business?
Which company was split off from SCI in 2024?
Which Indian company is a rival of SCI?

companies.note_30w: Shipping Corporation of India is the state-owned fleet carrying crude oil, cargo and gas, with tankers serving state refiners as its core business.

companies.name: Shyam Metalics and Energy

parts.SELLS: Shyam Metalics makes ferro alloys, iron pellets, sponge iron, steel billets, TMT bars sold under the SEL Tiger brand, stainless steel, and aluminium foil. It runs plants in West Bengal and Odisha with its own captive power.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling steel, ferro alloys and other metal products. Long products and ferro alloys are its main revenue sources, and captive power keeps costs low. Newer stainless steel and aluminium foil lines add higher-value sales.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger ferro alloy producers and a fast-growing mid-sized steel company in eastern India. It has also become one of the country's notable makers of aluminium foil.
parts.RIVALS: Jindal Steel, Sarda Energy & Minerals, Godawari Power & Ispat and Tata Steel's long products business in steel; Hindalco and others in aluminium foil.
parts.WATCH: Watch the expansion plans it approved in 2026, the ramp-up of stainless steel and aluminium products, its push into new value-added lines, and coal and iron ore costs.

quiz.prompt: Which TMT bar brand belongs to Shyam Metalics?
What keeps Shyam Metalics' costs low?
Which company is a rival of Shyam Metalics?

companies.note_30w: Shyam Metalics makes ferro alloys, steel, stainless steel and aluminium foil in eastern India, using captive power to keep production costs low.

companies.name: Siemens Energy India

parts.SELLS: Siemens Energy India makes power generation and transmission equipment: steam and gas turbines, generators, high-voltage transformers, switchgear and HVDC links. It was demerged from Siemens Ltd and listed separately in June 2025, as the Indian arm of Germany's Siemens Energy.
parts.EARNS: It earns from equipment orders and long service contracts. Grid technologies for power transmission are its largest and fastest-growing segment, while turbines and services for power plants and industry add the rest.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading power equipment makers, with a big position in high-voltage transmission. It draws on the global technology of Siemens Energy, one of the world's largest energy equipment groups.
parts.RIVALS: BHEL, GE Vernova T&D India, Hitachi Energy India, Hyosung and other transmission and turbine makers. In gas turbines it also competes with Mitsubishi Power.
parts.WATCH: Watch orders from India's large transmission build-out, including HVDC lines for renewable power, its factory expansions, and orders for gas turbines and services.

quiz.prompt: When did Siemens Energy India list separately?
Which is Siemens Energy India's largest segment?
Which company is a rival of Siemens Energy India?

companies.note_30w: Siemens Energy India, demerged from Siemens in 2025, makes turbines and grid equipment, with power transmission as its biggest and fastest-growing business.

companies.name: Signatureglobal

parts.SELLS: Signatureglobal builds and sells homes, mostly in Gurugram and around Delhi. It started with affordable housing under government schemes and has moved into mid-income and premium apartments and plotted developments, plus some retail space.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling apartments before and during construction and recognising revenue as projects are handed over. Mid-income and premium projects along new Gurugram corridors such as Sohna Road and Dwarka Expressway are now its main source of sales.
parts.SIZE: One of the largest homebuilders in Gurugram by sales and a top residential developer in the Delhi region. It moved from a small affordable-housing builder to a major listed developer within about a decade.
parts.RIVALS: DLF, Godrej Properties, Smartworld Developers, Experion and other Gurugram builders, plus the M3M group. Competition for land and buyers along new Gurugram corridors is intense.
parts.WATCH: Watch its new project launches in Gurugram, timely delivery of projects already sold, land purchases, and how housing demand in the Delhi region holds up.

quiz.prompt: Where are most Signatureglobal projects?
What did Signatureglobal start with?
Which developer is a rival to Signatureglobal?

companies.note_30w: Signatureglobal is a Gurugram homebuilder that grew from affordable housing into mid-income and premium apartments, making it a top residential developer around Delhi.

companies.name: Sobha

parts.SELLS: Sobha builds premium apartments, villas and plotted developments in Bengaluru, Gurugram, Kerala, Pune, Chennai and other cities. It is unusual in doing almost everything in-house, from design to concrete, glazing, furniture and interiors. It also builds campuses and offices for companies on contract.
parts.EARNS: It earns mainly by selling homes in its own projects; Bengaluru is its largest market. Contractual work for corporate clients and its manufacturing units add revenue and keep its in-house teams busy.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading premium homebuilders and among the largest residential developers in Bengaluru. It is known for quality and in-house execution rather than outsourcing work to contractors.
parts.RIVALS: Prestige Group, Brigade Enterprises, Godrej Properties and Puravankara in South India; DLF and other builders in Gurugram and the Delhi region. Each fights for land and buyers in the same premium segments.
parts.WATCH: Watch new launches across cities, its net-debt-free balance sheet and use of rights-issue money, and land purchases. Shareholders reappointed MD Jagadish Nangineni in 2026.

quiz.prompt: What makes Sobha unusual among builders?
options: It has no projects in Bengaluru
It is fully backward integrated, doing most work in-house

quiz.prompt: Which is Sobha's largest market?
Which developer is a rival of Sobha?

companies.note_30w: Sobha is a Bengaluru-based premium homebuilder that does nearly everything in-house, from concrete to interiors, and also builds campuses for companies.

companies.name: Sterlite Technologies (STL)

parts.SELLS: STL makes optical fibre, fibre-optic cables and connectivity products used to build telecom, broadband and data-centre networks. It sells to telecom operators, cloud companies and governments in India, Europe and the US. It split off its global IT services business into a separate company in 2025.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling optical fibre and cables, increasingly to data centres and hyperscale cloud firms. Optical networking products are now its core business, and exports form a large share of sales.

companies.name: Transformers and Rectifiers (India)

parts.SELLS: Transformers and Rectifiers (India), or TARIL, makes power, distribution and furnace transformers, rectifiers and reactors for power transmission utilities, renewable energy projects, railways and industry.
parts.EARNS: It earns by building transformers to order. Power transformers for state and central transmission utilities are its largest business, and renewable energy and export orders are growing fast.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading private transformer makers, able to build very high-voltage units for national transmission lines. Its main factories are near Ahmedabad.
parts.RIVALS: Hitachi Energy India, Siemens Energy India, CG Power, Voltamp Transformers and Bharat Bijlee. Demand currently exceeds supply across the industry, so delivery speed matters.
parts.WATCH: Watch orders from India's transmission build-out for renewable energy, its announced capacity expansions, and export orders. Copper and steel costs affect margins.

companies.name: Trident

parts.SELLS: Trident makes towels, bed sheets and bath linen, mostly for big US and European retailers, plus cotton yarn and paper made from wheat straw. Its home textiles are also sold under its own brands in India.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling home textiles to global retailers and yarn and paper in India. Home textiles bring the largest share of revenue, and the US is its biggest export market.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's largest makers of terry towels and a leading Indian home textiles exporter, with big integrated plants in Punjab and Madhya Pradesh.
parts.RIVALS: Welspun Living, Indo Count Industries, Himatsingka Seide and Vardhman Textiles, plus exporters in Pakistan, China and Bangladesh. Pricing against Asian exporters is a constant pressure.
parts.WATCH: Watch US tariffs on Indian textiles, the India-UK trade deal, demand from US retailers, and cotton prices. Its paper business adds a separate line to follow.

companies.name: Triveni Turbine

parts.SELLS: Triveni Turbine makes industrial steam turbines used by sugar, steel, cement, paper and chemical plants and waste-to-energy projects to generate power, and offers servicing and spare parts. It sells in India and abroad.
parts.EARNS: It earns by building turbines to order and from aftermarket service and parts. Exports are a large and growing share of orders, and aftermarket work brings high margins.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's leading makers of small industrial steam turbines, with installations in many countries. Exports now make up a large part of its order book.
parts.RIVALS: Siemens Energy, BHEL, MAN Energy Solutions and Chinese turbine makers. It focuses on smaller industrial turbines, a niche where it is a recognised global leader.
parts.WATCH: Watch export orders, its entry into larger turbines, and demand from waste heat recovery and renewable energy projects. Its aftermarket business adds steady income.

companies.name: UCO Bank

parts.SELLS: UCO Bank is a government-owned bank based in Kolkata. It offers deposits, home loans, vehicle loans, farm loans and loans to small businesses and companies through branches across India, especially in the east, and has overseas branches in Singapore and Hong Kong.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between interest on loans and interest on deposits, plus fees. Retail, farm and small business loans make up a growing share of its book, while corporate lending remains large.
parts.SIZE: One of India's smaller public sector banks, with a strong branch presence in West Bengal and eastern India. It also has a modest overseas presence in Singapore and Hong Kong.
parts.RIVALS: Bank of India, Central Bank of India, Indian Overseas Bank, Punjab & Sind Bank and private banks. State-owned banks compete closely on deposits and government business.
parts.WATCH: It has had no full-time chief since Ashwani Kumar's term ended in May 2026; Rajendra Kumar Saboo holds charge while a successor is chosen. Watch the government's plan to cut its stake.
